generated: generated by node build.mjs from plugins.json — advisory only; a document embeds its own pins

nanoid.label: Nano ID
nanoid.description: Tiny id generator (477 bytes, no imports). Useful to a plugin that needs stable ids: nanoid(), customAlphabet().

citations.label: Citations
citations.about: Inline citations and a bibliography: type @@ to pick a reference, import BibTeX or CSL-JSON, or read a Zotero library. Only cited entries are written into the document, and a document without the plugin still reads correctly.

genome.label: Genome map
genome.about: A GenomeSpy map as a figure: pick a .spec.json, hover a gene, clamp the window to the locus, and export the engine's own SVG on print and PDF.

pandoc-export.label: Pandoc export
pandoc-export.about: Word, typeset PDF, Typst and Markdown, converted in the tab by pandoc.wasm. The engine itself is fetched on the first export; nothing is uploaded.
